items.briefing:
Macquarie Technology has launched a dedicated security centre aimed at supporting Australian universities, which is worth noting for those in the education and training sector — this kind of initiative can improve the cyber resilience of institutions handling sensitive student data. Separately, new Buy Now Pay Later regulations in Australia are placing greater emphasis on data quality, meaning organisations that collect or share customer financial information need to ensure their records are accurate and up to date to stay compliant.

**Practical tip:** If your organisation collects customer or student data, take a moment to review whether your records are current and accurate — outdated data can create both compliance and security risks.

featured.title: Macquarie launches security centre for universities
featured.quote: Universities face October deadline; local 24/7 monitoring helps protect critical research and student data.
